lessons.title: What Is Winter Weather Like?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe features of winter weather (cold, frost, short days).
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss today's weather outside.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss and observe winter weather features using pictures and (if available) real outdoor observation.
key_questions: What is the weather like today?
What makes winter different from summer?

differentiation.extension: Compare winter to other seasons in detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note seasonal weather vocabulary — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Recap winter weather features.
lessons.home_link: Notice and describe today's weather with family.

lessons.title: Story Time: 'The Snowy Day' by Ezra Jack Keats
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe what the character did in the snow.
lessons.starter_activity: Predict from the cover.
lessons.main_activity: Read 'The Snowy Day', discussing what Peter does and how he feels.
key_questions: What did Peter do in the snow?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension and emotional understanding — evidence for LIT.1.
lessons.plenary: Discuss favourite part of the story.
lessons.home_link: Talk about a time you played outside in cold weather.

lessons.title: Counting Snowflakes
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to count paper snowflakes accurately up to 10.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at snowflake shapes/pictures.
lessons.main_activity: Children count and sort paper snowflake cut-outs into groups, recording totals.
key_questions: Can you count them again to check?
lessons.assessment_notes: Record counting accuracy — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.plenary: Class total snowflake count.
lessons.home_link: Count small objects at home together.

lessons.title: Making Paper Snowflakes
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to fold and cut paper to create a symmetrical snowflake.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at real/picture snowflakes and their symmetry.
lessons.main_activity: Children fold paper and cut simple shapes (with adult support) to reveal a symmetrical snowflake pattern.

differentiation.extension: Create a more detailed symmetrical pattern

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe cutting control and symmetry understanding — evidence for EAD.1/PD.2/MATHS.2.
lessons.plenary: Display snowflakes together as a class display.
lessons.home_link: Make a paper snowflake together at home.

lessons.title: Exploring Ice: Freezing and Melting
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to observe and describe ice melting.
lessons.starter_activity: Predict what will happen to an ice cube left out.
lessons.main_activity: Children observe ice cubes melting over the session, recording changes with simple drawings/words.
key_questions: What is happening to the ice?

differentiation.extension: Predict and time the melting process

lessons.assessment_notes: Note investigative observation of states of matter — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Recap what happened to the ice.
lessons.home_link: Freeze and melt ice together at home safely.

lessons.title: Phonics: Introducing 'z'
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to say the sound 'z' and blend words (zip, zap, zoo).
lessons.starter_activity: Recap sounds learned so far.
lessons.main_activity: Introduce 'z' sound/action; blend new CVC words.
lessons.assessment_notes: Update phonics tracker for 'z'.
lessons.plenary: Sing all 24 sounds learned (all single letter sounds complete).
lessons.home_link: Practise blending zip, zap, zoo.

lessons.title: Measuring Icicle Lengths (Non-Standard Units)
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to compare lengths using non-standard units (cubes).
lessons.starter_activity: Compare two paper icicle cut-outs by eye.
lessons.main_activity: Children measure paper icicle cut-outs using linking cubes, comparing lengths.
key_questions: How many cubes long is this icicle?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note early measurement skill — evidence for MATHS.2.
lessons.plenary: Class recap of longest/shortest icicles measured.
lessons.home_link: Measure objects at home using non-standard units (e.g. hand spans).

lessons.title: Winter Weather Movement
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to move expressively representing different winter weather (snow falling, wind blowing, ice skating).
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss how snow falls gently vs wind blows strongly.
lessons.main_activity: Children move expressively to music representing falling snow, blowing wind, and gliding on ice.
key_questions: Can you glide like you're on ice?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe expressive movement — evidence for EAD.2/PD.1.
lessons.plenary: Discuss favourite winter movement performed.
lessons.home_link: Move like falling snow or blowing wind together at home.

lessons.title: Dressing for Cold Weather
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to identify appropriate clothing to keep warm in winter.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what we wear when it's cold.
lessons.main_activity: Sort clothing picture cards into 'keeps us warm' vs 'not for winter', discussing layering.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note understanding of weather-appropriate clothing — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Recap winter clothing needs.
lessons.home_link: Choose appropriate winter clothing together before going out.

lessons.title: Writing Winter Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to attempt to write simple winter-themed words.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all sounds learned so far.
lessons.main_activity: Children write/draw simple winter words (snow, ice) using known phonics sounds.
key_questions: What winter word will you write?
What sound does it start with?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note writing progress — evidence for LIT.3.
lessons.plenary: Share winter word pictures with a partner.
lessons.home_link: Write a winter word together at home.

lessons.title: Number Bonds to 10 Introduction
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to explore combinations that make 10 using concrete objects.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap number bonds to 5.
lessons.main_activity: Using snowflake/mitten counters, children explore different combinations making 10, recording with drawings.

differentiation.support: Use a ten-frame and physical counters

lessons.assessment_notes: Note early number bond to 10 understanding — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.plenary: Class collects all the different ways to make 10 found.
lessons.home_link: Find ways to make 10 using toys or snacks at home.

lessons.title: Winter Scene Collage
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to use white/blue/silver materials to create a winter scene.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at winter scene pictures for inspiration.
lessons.main_activity: Children create a winter scene collage using cotton wool (snow), blue paper (sky), and silver/white materials.
key_questions: What is happening in your winter scene?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe creative material use — evidence for EAD.1.
lessons.plenary: Display winter scene collages.
lessons.home_link: Look at winter scenes/pictures together and talk about what you see.

lessons.title: Animals in Winter
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe how one animal survives in winter weather.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap hibernation from the autumn term.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss how animals like polar bears (thick fur), birds (fluffing feathers), and hibernating animals survive winter.
key_questions: How does a polar bear stay warm?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note understanding of animal adaptation — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Recap how different animals survive winter.
lessons.home_link: Look up how an animal survives winter together.

lessons.title: Story Time: 'The Gruffalo's Child' (Snow Setting)
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe the snowy setting of the story.
lessons.starter_activity: Predict from the cover.
lessons.main_activity: Read the story, discussing how the snowy setting affects the characters and their adventure.
key_questions: What is the weather like in the story?
How does the snow affect the characters?

differentiation.extension: Explain how setting affects the story

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension of setting's role in a story — evidence for LIT.1.
lessons.plenary: Discuss the story's snowy adventure.
lessons.home_link: Look at a story with a winter setting together.

lessons.title: Sorting Winter Clothing by Type
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to sort objects using more than one criterion.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at a mixed pile of winter clothing pictures.
lessons.main_activity: Children sort winter clothing cards by type (hats, gloves, coats) and then re-sort by colour, explaining choices.
key_questions: Can you sort them a different way?

differentiation.extension: Sort by 2+ criteria and explain reasoning

lessons.assessment_notes: Note sorting/classifying skill — evidence for MATHS.2.
lessons.plenary: Share different sorting methods used.
lessons.home_link: Sort winter clothing at home by type or colour.

lessons.title: Winter Song and Dance
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to sing a winter-themed song with actions.
lessons.starter_activity: Listen to a winter-themed song.
lessons.main_activity: Learn simple actions/movements to a winter song (e.g. about snowflakes or snowmen), performing with confidence.
key_questions: What action goes with this line?
How does the song make you feel?

differentiation.extension: Suggest and lead a new action

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe participation and expressive movement — evidence for EAD.2.
lessons.plenary: Perform the song once more.
lessons.home_link: Sing the winter song for family.

lessons.title: Winter Weather Recap Display
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise key facts about winter weather learned this week.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's UTW learning.
lessons.main_activity: Contribute to a class 'Winter Weather' display summarising ice, clothing, and animal survival learning.
key_questions: What have we learned about winter weather?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the week's learning — evidence for UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Unveil the finished display.
lessons.home_link: Share what you learned about winter weather with your family.

lessons.title: Phonics Review: All 24 Single Sounds Complete
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read CVC words and simple sentences using all single-letter sounds.
lessons.starter_activity: Quick-fire flashcard review of all 24 sounds.
lessons.main_activity: Phonics stations: word-building, CVC reading cards, simple sentence reading, celebrating completion of all single-letter sounds.
key_questions: Can you build and read this word?
lessons.assessment_notes: Finalise tracker: all single-letter sounds now introduced; note readiness to begin digraphs next.
lessons.plenary: Big celebration for completing all single-letter sounds!
lessons.home_link: Practise reading simple sentences over the weekend.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Counting, Measuring, Number Bonds to 10
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply counting, measuring, and number bonds to 10 skills from this week.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's maths vocabulary.
lessons.main_activity: Rotate through 3 stations: counting snowflakes, measuring icicles, number bonds to 10.
lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise week 16 maths observations.
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining all three skills.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising number bonds to 10 over the weekend.

lessons.title: Winter Weather Celebration Performance
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to perform the week's song/movement with confidence.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all elements learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Whole-class performance combining the winter song and expressive movements, with snowflake/scene craft displayed.
resources_needed: Craft from the week, music player
key_questions: What was your favourite part of this week?
How did it feel to perform?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe confidence and enjoyment — evidence for EAD.2.
lessons.plenary: Round of applause; recap the winter weather week.
lessons.home_link: Perform the song/movement for family this weekend.
